exposure: Multimorbidity and recurrence patterns across three consecutive births
cohort: The study included 7714 primiparous mothers from Queensland, Australia, who delivered three consecutive singleton live births between January 2009 and December 2015.
finding: A small but highly morbid class of neonatal deliveries was identified, exhibiting strong continuity across three consecutive births (odds ratios >10), independent of a range of maternal and pregnancy-related factors.
